messages:
Maya Patel: ACME security just returned the vendor risk questionnaire. Key asks: exact embeddings retention policy, whether embeddings can be pseudonymized on ingest, BYOK for KMS, and SOC2 artefacts for logging/access reviews. They want answers today if possible.

Ankit Rao: I'll take the retention/pseudonymization bits. Current policy: hosted tier retains embeddings for 90 days; Dedicated/Private customers can configure retention down to 0 days (delete on ingest). Recommend we offer to shorten to 30 days for ACME while they evaluate. For pseudonymization: we advise customers to remove direct identifiers before embedding; we don't mutate input by default.

Jordan Lee: For the SOC2 artefacts, I can pull the standard onboard bundle: control mapping, sample runbook, access review snapshot, logging screenshots. Will sanitize tenant IDs.

Priya Singh: Legal: clarify phrasing around "we do not attempt re-identification" vs "we do not perform automated re-identification efforts". Use the latter. Also include the deletion request flow and SLA for deletion (we typically honor within 5 business days for hosted; immediate for Dedicated/Private if customer provides API/contracted path).

Maya Patel: Good point. ACME also asked if evaluation traces (used for model quality) ever contain raw prompts from customers. We're storing eval traces for 60 days by default and those may include customer prompts unless redaction is turned on. Can we redact automatically?

Ankit Rao: We don't automatically redact user content from evaluation traces unless the customer opts in for redaction or we have a legal request. We can offer ACME an opt-in to disable storing raw prompts in eval traces for their tenant.

OpsBot: Auto-notice: Generated evidence package template v2 uploaded to internal S3 path by Jordan Lee. Link will expire in 7 days.

Jordan Lee: Upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-1764227777/evidence_v2.zip (presigned link shared in calendar invite). Command used: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-1764227777/evidence_v2.zip --expires-in 604800
```

Maya Patel: Can we confirm BYOK specifics? ACME expects BYOK for embeddings-at-rest and wants key provenance logs.

Jordan Lee: Technical answer: Dedicated & Private support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). We key-wrap embeddings and outputs with the customer's key. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default; BYOK is only available on Private/Dedicated or under an enterprise contract and deployment. We can provide key rotation proof and KMS audit logs for Private/Dedicated.

Priya Singh: I'll prepare the exact DPA excerpt and add language about key provenance and audit log export for Dedicated/Private. Also add the deletion SLA language for hosted vs dedicated/private.

Maya Patel: Thanks. I'll propose a 30-minute walkthrough with ACME security: Wed 3pm PST. Jordan/Ankit/Priya pls confirm. I'll include the presigned evidence link and the drafted DPA excerpt in the invite.

Ankit Rao: Confirmed for Wed 3pm PST.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed.

Priya Singh: Confirmed. Draft to Maya by EOD.

Maya Patel: Action items: 1) Legal finalize DPA excerpt and deletion/BYOK wording (Priya) 2) Eng export sanitized evidence + dataflow diagram (Jordan) 3) CS to offer retention reduction/opt-in redaction and file risk note if evidence delayed >5 business days (Maya/Ankit). I'll mark as medium renewal risk if onboarding stalls.

Maya Patel: I'll send ACME the bundle after sign-off and record the thread outcome here. Closing thread after meeting and ACME ack. :white_check_mark:
